scenes.ira007:
Built-in imagegen; new generation without image inputs.

Create a completely NEW live-action photographic cinematic still from scratch, not a retouch, not an upscale. Landscape 3:2 medium two-shot in a lived-in spacecraft school workshop. Two fourteen-year-old female classmates conversing naturally across a corner of a workbench. Frame from mid torso upward so faces are large enough to resolve genuine photographic detail. Both faces near the same focus distance.

LEFT: Zhanna, short slim teenage girl with a short black layered haircut with loose fringe, natural brown eyes, pale gently freckled skin, small straight nose, subtly uneven brows and youthful softly defined jaw. Worn blue-gray overshirt over a charcoal-gray crewneck tee. She turns slightly toward her friend to listen with quiet attentive interest, mouth relaxed, direct eyeline into her friend's eyes. One anatomically correct hand rests naturally on the near workbench corner.
RIGHT: Ira, blonde teenage girl with two small short ponytails tied low behind her ears, small dangling chain earrings, gray buttoned shirt and dark charcoal work overalls. Natural youthful face, slightly rounder cheeks, realistic modest smile while talking to Zhanna, looking directly at her. Holds a small closed notebook with two naturally placed hands at waist height. No glamour makeup. Ordinary age-appropriate fully clothed school characters, no posing.

Optical appearance: clean high-resolution still-camera photograph, 75mm equivalent lens from a believable camera distance, f/5.6 depth of field across both entire faces, nose eyelids lips and cheek skin clearly resolved, background optically defocused. No soft face restoration, no digital smoothing, no diffusion over faces, no motion blur. Natural lens rendering without oversharpening. Do not render all background objects equally sharp.

REGIONAL SKIN, must be resolved at the actual face scale: fine uneven forehead microrelief and subtle tonal differences; delicate thin skin around eyelids with fine intersecting folds appropriate to youth, moist lower lid edge and distinct irregularly spaced eyelashes. Small irregular pores more visible beside nose and inner cheek, progressively finer toward temples and outer cheek; very fine peach fuzz caught selectively by side light. Nose lightly reflective, cheeks more matte, restrained warm cheek color, slight nostril redness, cooler under-eye tone. Sparse freckles have variable size and density, not a uniform noise pattern. Brows are individual growth-directed hairs. Lips show delicate vertical creases and soft irregular edges with natural muted color. Eyes have sharply readable dark irises, coherent pupils, small physically consistent catchlights, off-white sclera. Preserve youth: no heavy wrinkles, pitted oversized pores, artificial grunge or makeup.

CINEMATIC LIGHT: nuanced shaped cool-neutral window light from frame right, grazing the blonde hair and turning softly across both faces. A warm work lamp behind left frame edge creates a restrained amber rim on black hair and shoulder, with a weak warm tabletop bounce. Negative fill sculpts the shadow side of each face while eyes remain clearly readable. Background doorway about two stops darker than faces, small warm practical deep inside. Broad soft edged structural shadow on rear wall. Natural skin color, rich uncrushed blacks, realistic highlight rolloff. Not uniformly bright, not muddy. Workshop pale metal cabinets and a tablet remain quiet background context, only one modest plant, no visual clutter.

Photograph with convincing living faces and physically coherent anatomy, natural ear placement, necks and shoulders. Clean fabric without excessive texture sharpening. No grain overlay, no procedural skin noise, no painted detail, no CGI or wax skin, no glossy advertising treatment, no text or collage. Focus priority: faces and exchanged gaze, then hands, then environment.
scenes.senka007:
Built-in imagegen; new generation without input images. Preview, not published.

Create a completely NEW photographic cinema frame from scratch: an intimate family tea conversation in the lived-in Oval refuge of a spacecraft, ALIVE. A candid live-action photograph, never an illustration or CGI. Landscape 16:9. Four people only, seated closely along a shallow arc at the far side and ends of a modest table, close waist-up ensemble framing; their four faces occupy substantial image area at comparable camera distances. Camera at their seated eye level. Natural 55mm full-frame perspective, optical depth of field roughly f/5.6, resolve all four faces; foreground table edge slightly soft and distant room gently defocused.

Cast left to right:
DINA: young woman, long straight black hair, warm medium skin, subtle chin dimple, brown wool plaid shirt, small intricate pendant, natural expressive dark eyes.
RITA: young woman with loosely parted shoulder-length light brown hair, narrow softly defined face, brown overshirt and faded gray tee, comfortably wrapped in a subdued wool blanket. Both hands gently hold a simple enamel mug with coherent fingers around its body.
SENKA: twelve-year-old boy with fair tousled blond hair, youthful believable face, olive crewneck shirt, slender child proportions, no adult jaw or musculature.
INNA: young woman with untidy red hair, round face, large light eyes, natural freckles, oatmeal button shirt and dark woven vest.
Preserve their distinctly different facial structures; no identical model faces.

Action: Senka is halfway through an excited story about a strategy game, turning toward Rita with a spontaneous modest smile; one relaxed hand makes a small conversational gesture just above the table, other rests beside his closed tablet. Rita listens directly to him with a small tired affectionate smile. Dina watches the boy with quiet amusement. Inna watches him too while gently setting a plate of apple slices on the table, one coherent arm and anatomically correct hand. Clear eyeline relationships, never all looking at camera. Natural asymmetry in expression, no staged advertising smiles. Proper shoulders, wrists and five-finger hands with plausible grip and support.

Room: warm modest ship refuge; painted flowers and butterflies on old pale wall panels, beds with colorful blankets softly visible in the rear. Restrained background, no rust or decorative clutter. On table only four simple enamel mugs, small bread board, apple plate, closed tablet and a very small vase of dried flowers toward the out-of-focus near edge. Cloth and objects subordinate to faces. No body intersecting table.

PHOTOGRAPHIC FACE DETAIL AT MULTIPLE SCALES:
Regional skin rather than uniform texture. Foreheads have fine irregular microrelief and tiny local tone differences. Eyelids have delicate thin skin, age-appropriate fine folds, accurate wet lower lid edges and separately resolved irregular lashes. Tiny irregular pores beside nostrils and inner cheeks, finer surface toward outer cheeks and temples. Mostly matte cheeks with a little peach fuzz caught by side light; restrained nose sheen, slightly warmer cheeks, subtle cooler under-eye tone. Freckles particularly on Inna vary naturally in size, spacing and intensity. Lips have fine vertical creases, soft irregular edges, natural muted color. Brows individual growth-directed hairs. Eyes have coherent pupils, distinct iris boundaries, small source-motivated catchlights and off-white sclera. Preserve youthful ages, no enlarged pores, heavy wrinkles, excessive acne, gritty dirt, makeup or porcelain skin. All eyes, visible cheeks, lips and noses within the crisp focus zone. No face restoration, no beauty smoothing.

MOTIVATED CINEMATIC LIGHTING:
A broad warm shaded practical source above and slightly beyond the table on camera right shapes the boy and Inna with soft directional highlights and natural cheek/chin shadows; subdued bounced tabletop light supports the left two listeners. A cool-neutral light from the left doorway brushes Dina's hair and shoulders and provides a subtle cooler side tone. Restrained negative fill adds facial volume, all eyes remain readable. Set skin exposure correctly and let beds and walls sit about two stops below faces, with one small distant amber practical pool. Nuanced warm/cool sources rather than a global orange filter, natural skin color differences, rich clean shadows, gentle highlight rolloff, selective ceramic reflections, no theatrical shafts or fog. The emotional effect is home and human warmth within a ship.

Clean photographic sensor-like image without added film grain. Real natural skin is the detailed subject, background and textiles remain quieter. No noise overlay, procedural pore stamps, HDR, oversharpening, halos, gritty fabric, painterly skin, wax models or hypergloss. Priority: individual faces and contact between people, anatomy, coherent light, then setting. One cinematic photo, no collage, no text.
